bullets.section: Article I’m reading and thinking about a lot —
bullets.title: How Sia Saved Herself
bullets.creator: Hillel Aron
bullets.note: ([@hillelaron](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/zlue04m77unhp0dr4i0/33tphkhn66gdek/aHR0cHM6Ly90d2l0dGVyLmNvbS9oaWxsZWxhcm9u)). After [my short tweetstorm on the dangers of public exposure](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/zlue04m77unhp0dr4i0/4mcvhehnzz8243/aHR0cHM6Ly90d2l0dGVyLmNvbS90ZmVycmlzcy9zdGF0dXMvMTIyMzAxMzIzNjY5OTgwMzY0OQ==), reader Bryan Elliott ([@BryanElliott](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/zlue04m77unhp0dr4i0/r4s8hohe99z5g8/aHR0cHM6Ly90d2l0dGVyLmNvbS9CcnlhbkVsbGlvdHQvc3RhdHVzLzEyMjMwODg2OTkzNTg4NTkyNjY=)) recommended this to me. What does fame look like without a face? Is it possible to be a pop star while breaking many of the supposed “rules”? Read this and find out. Excellent piece.

bullets.title: Johannes Stötter
bullets.note: ([@johannesstoetterart](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/zlue04m77unhp0dr4i0/lqbehmhz557kx0/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuaW5zdGFncmFtLmNvbS9qb2hhbm5lc3N0b2V0dGVyYXJ0Lw==)). I originally came across [this video](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/zlue04m77unhp0dr4i0/dkheh0hmzzn7po/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuaW5zdGFncmFtLmNvbS9wL0I4N2lyRFVuajNQLw==), which I later learned was posted by [@bodypainting\_festival](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/zlue04m77unhp0dr4i0/7ku7h8hmvv54n8/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuaW5zdGFncmFtLmNvbS9ib2R5cGFpbnRpbmdfZmVzdGl2YWwv) (great account to follow). It completely blew my mind. Subsequently, I was pointed to [this video](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/zlue04m77unhp0dr4i0/zoighnh899xdlr/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cueW91dHViZS5jb20vd2F0Y2g_dj12dlBJRXhSTzc1RSZhcHA9ZGVza3RvcA==) of the [behind the scenes footage](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/zlue04m77unhp0dr4i0/plfeh9hlkko7q5/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cueW91dHViZS5jb20vd2F0Y2g_dj12dlBJRXhSTzc1RSZhcHA9ZGVza3RvcA==) of the creation process. Sincere thanks to [@joshbatalibasi](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/zlue04m77unhp0dr4i0/kotmh6h3ggv9x9/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuaW5zdGFncmFtLmNvbS9qb3NoYmF0YWxpYmFzaS8=), [@stephrsparks](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/zlue04m77unhp0dr4i0/24c2hoherrwom7/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuaW5zdGFncmFtLmNvbS9zdGVwaHJzcGFya3Mv), [@robyn.isabel](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/zlue04m77unhp0dr4i0/g5snh5hk77wzq3/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuaW5zdGFncmFtLmNvbS9yb2J5bi5pc2FiZWwv), [@shivamansur](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/zlue04m77unhp0dr4i0/39aphkhn66gdp3/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuaW5zdGFncmFtLmNvbS9zaGl2YW1hbnN1ci8=), and others who identified the artist: [Johannes Stötter](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/zlue04m77unhp0dr4i0/67beh8hdvve29k/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuaW5zdGFncmFtLmNvbS9qb2hhbm5lc3N0b2V0dGVyYXJ0Lw==). Also, kudos to Brett Backus ([@backusbuilt](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/zlue04m77unhp0dr4i0/rxh8hohe99z56x/aHR0cHM6Ly90d2l0dGVyLmNvbS9iYWNrdXNidWlsdC9zdGF0dXMvMTIzMTc1MDQ1MzE2NTA1NjAwMQ==)) for sending me [this equally brain-bending video of turning humans into frogs and chameleons](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/zlue04m77unhp0dr4i0/8luqhohxeen5rk/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cueW91dHViZS5jb20vd2F0Y2g_dj02ZDZjSnU5ZGFnZyZmZWF0dXJlPXlvdXR1LmJl). Don’t miss that either.

He is an author of more than 250 peer-reviewed publications on antimicrobial resistance, epidemiologic methods, mathematical modeling of infectious disease transmission, pathogen population genomics, and immunoepidemiology of _Streptococcus pneumoniae_.

bullets.section: What I’m watching (again) to counterbalance the bullet above —
bullets.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
bullets.note: , starting with Season 1, Episode 1. To decompress and destress at the end of each day, I’ve been watching one 22-minute episode of this show, which features an all-star cast and is wonderfully ridiculous. The show gets stronger and stronger with each episode. My 2017 interview with Terry Crews (“[Terry Crews — How to Have, Do, and Be All You Want](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/zlue04m77unhp0dr4i0/74t7h8hmvv54nl/aHR0cHM6Ly90aW0uYmxvZy8yMDE3LzEyLzIwL3RlcnJ5LWNyZXdzLWhvdy10by1oYXZlLWRvLWFuZC1iZS1hbGwteW91LXdhbnQvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9Y29udmVydGtpdCZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWNvbnZlcnRraXQmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTViZg==)”) convinced me to start with the very first and work my way through.
